CORPORATE PROFILE
企業簡介
Chow Tai Fook Jewellery Group Limited (the “Group”; SEHK stock code: 1929) was listed on the
Main Board of The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong in December 2011. The Group’s vision is to
become the most trusted jewellery group in the world.


Founded in 1929, the Group’s iconic brand “CHOW TAI FOOK” is widely recognised for its
trustworthiness and authenticity, and is renowned for its product design, quality and value. A long-
standing commitment to innovation and craftsmanship has contributed to the Group’s success,
along with that of its iconic retail brand, and has been embodied in its rich heritage. Underpinning
this success are our long-held core values of “Sincerity • Eternity”.


The Group’s differentiation strategy continues to make inroads into diverse customer segments
by catering to a bespoke experience for different lifestyles and personalities, as well as customers’
different life stages. Offering a wide variety of products, services and channels, the Group’s brand
portfolio comprises the CHOW TAI FOOK flagship brand with curated retail experiences, and other
individual brands including HEARTS ON FIRE, ENZO, SOINLOVE and MONOLOGUE.


The Group’s commitment to sustainable growth is anchored in its customer-centric focus and
strategies, which are in place to promote long-term innovation in business, in people and in
culture. Another asset underpinning sustainable growth is a sophisticated and agile business
model. This supports the Group by fostering excellence and extending opportunities along the
entire value chain to communities and industry partners across the world.


With an extensive retail network in China, Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia, the United States and
Canada, as well as a fast-growing smart retail business, the Group is implementing effective
online-to-offline (“O2O”) strategies to succeed in today’s omni-channel retail environment.


周大福珠寶集團有限公司 (「 集團」; 香港聯交所股份代號 :1929) 於 2011 年 12 月在香港聯合交易所主板
上市，以成為全球最值得信賴的珠寶集團為願景。


集團標誌性品牌「周大福」創立於 1929 年，廣獲認同為信譽及正貨的象徵，並以產品設計、品質與價
值而聞名。集團及其標誌性品牌的成功，從過去的悠久歷史，體現出對創新和工藝的持久堅持，以及
恒久抱持的核心價值「真誠 • 永恒」。


周大福憑藉差異化策略在不同顧客群的市場穩步發展，並提供貼心的消費體驗。透過提供多元化的
產品、服務和銷售渠道，滿足顧客不同人生階段的需要。集團的差異化品牌策略以周大福旗艦品牌為
核心，並相繼推出針對性的零售體驗，以及 HEARTS ON FIRE、ENZO、SOINLOVE 與 MONOLOGUE
等其他個性品牌，每個品牌都承載著不同顧客群的生活態度和個性。


集團借助以客為本的方針及策略，實踐業務可持續增長的承諾，致力於業務、員工和文化方面推動長
遠的創新發展。發展成熟的靈活業務模式是推動集團可持續增長的一大優勢，在整個價值鏈中支持集
團追求卓越，以及延伸商機至不同社區和全球的行業合作夥伴。


集團擁有龐大的零售網絡，遍及中國、日本、韓國、東南亞、美國及加拿大，並經營發展迅速的智慧
零售業務，能有效地執行線上線下策略，在現今的全渠道零售環境下成功突圍而出。

2   Overview
    概覽
                                                                                             Chow Tai Fook Jewellery Group Limited
                                                                                                         周大福珠寶集團有限公司
ANNUAL RESULTS AT A GLANCE
年度業績概覽

KEY HIGHLIGHTS

•     The pandemic in Mainland China (the “Mainland”) had affected all businesses, ours inclusive, particularly in 3QFY2023.
      Our steady expansion of the retail network, combined with the recovery post the shift in pandemic-control measures
      in 4QFY2023, helped mitigating majority of the impact during the financial year. Revenue for FY2023 remained resilient
      with a decline of 4.3% year-on-year to HK$94,684 million


•     The Group’s commitment to disciplined cost management and pricing strategy optimisation yielded resilient underlying
      performance in FY2023 and sequential improvement in profitability in 2HFY2023. The enhancement in retail like-for-like
      gross profit margin mitigated the impact of increased gold and wholesale revenue contribution in the financial year.
      Adjusted gross profit margin improved 30 basis points to 23.7% during the year while core operating profit margin
      remained stable at 10.0%


•     In FY2023, the Wonderful Life Collection, a perfect blend of exquisite gold craftsmanship and T MARK diamonds, was
      successfully launched in the Mainland and its sales performance exceeded our expectation


•     As at 31 March 2023, we had a total of 7,269 CHOW TAI FOOK JEWELLERY POS in the Mainland, surpassing the 7,000
      target for FY2025. Our future growth plan will focus on quality expansion, enhancing store productivity of existing retail
      network and delivering exceptional customer experience


•     The Group is committed to building business resilience by taking a proactive and responsive approach. During FY2023,
      the Board initiated and endorsed the five strategic priorities. Each priority has outlined workplans and actions items
      serving to strengthen our competitiveness, enhance quality of earnings and drive sustainable long-term stakeholder
      value creation. These priorities include targeted brand positioning, product optimisation, operational efficiency,
      comprehensive talent cultivation, and accelerated digitalisation




主要重點

•     在中國內地（「內地」），不同行業均受疫情影響，我們的業務亦不例外。此影響於 2023 財政年度第三季度最為明顯。然而，
      我們在內地穩步擴張零售網絡，加上 2023 財政年度第四季度的防疫措施轉變帶動復甦，均有助減輕疫情對本財年的大部分
      影響。該財年內，本集團的營業額展現韌性，按年下降 4.3% 至 94,684 百萬港元


•     本集團致力採取嚴謹的成本管理與優化定價策略，令業務在 2023 財政年度表現堅韌，並促進了本財年下半年的盈利能力持
      續提升。本財年內，零售產品毛利率提高，緩解了黃金和批發營業額佔比增加的影響，經調整後的毛利率因此上升 30 個點
      子至 23.7%，而主要經營溢利率則穩定在 10.0%


•     2023 財政年度，集團在內地成功推出完美結合極緻黃金工藝與 T MARK 天然美鑽的人生四美系列，其銷售表現超出預期


•     於 2023 年 3 月 31 日，我們於內地共有 7,269 個周大福珠寶零售點，超越為 2025 財政年度定下開設 7,000 間門店的目標。
      我們未來的業務增長計劃將專注於高質量擴張、提升現有零售網絡的門店效益及提供卓越的顧客體驗


•     本集團致力透過積極、靈活的營運模式，締造業務韌性。2023 財政年度，董事會訂立及通過了五大策略方針，每項方針都
      概述了不同範疇的工作計劃及行動綱領，以提升我們的競爭力及盈利質素，並為所有持份者創造可持續的長遠價值。該等
      方針包括精準打造品牌定位、優化產品、優化營運效率、全面強化人才培育及加速數字化轉型升級

     MARKET REVIEW
     市場回顧
     The financial year 2023 was characterised by ongoing geopolitical     2023 財政年度，在地緣政治局勢緊張、經濟受壓及疫

• We use adjusted gross profit margin, a non-IFRS measure, for           • 我們以經調整後的毛利率（非按國際財務報告準則
   analysis. It represents gross profit margin generated from the          計算）作分析，相當於由業務所得的毛利率扣除黃
   business after eliminating the effect of unrealised loss (gain) on      金借貸的未變現虧損（收益）的影響，我們相信此數
   gold loans. We believe that this measure better reflects the            據更能反映集團的經營表現及有助了解業務的實
   operational performance of the Group and is useful for the              際趨勢。
   understanding of the underlying trend of its businesses.

• We use gold loans (short position in gold) for economic hedge          • 我們利用黃金借貸（黃金淡倉）為經濟避險目的，以
   purpose to mitigate the financial impact of the gold price              減輕黃金存貨（黃金好倉）價格波動的財務影響。黃
   fluctuations in our gold inventories (long position). The long-term     金好淡倉的長線影響預期將會在出售黃金存貨時互
   effect of long and short positions in gold is expected to offset        相抵銷，惟對報告期末的持倉狀況而言，或會產生
   each other through the sales of gold inventories. However,              短暫的時間差。於報告期末，未償還的黃金借貸合
   when we take a snapshot position, a short-term timing                   約會就市場價格進行重估，而除非出現減值跡象，
   difference may arise. The unsettled gold loan contracts are             以加權平均成本計量的黃金存貨並不會進行重估。
   revalued at market price at the end of the reporting period,
   while the gold inventories are not revalued as it is measured at
   weighted average cost, unless an impairment indicator exists.

EFFECT OF RMB FLUCTUATION                                                人民幣波動的影響
• As part of our business operation is in Mainland China, the            • 由於我們有部分業務在中國內地經營，人民幣的波
   fluctuation in RMB would have some impact on our performance.          動對我們的表現構成若干影響。


• Transactions entered by the Hong Kong entities but                     • 香港公司以人民幣計值的交易（包括與中國內地附
   denominated in RMB, including the inter-group transactions             屬公司進行的集團間交易）會按交易當天的現貨匯
   with the Mainland China subsidiaries, are converted into HKD,          率兌換為港元，即本集團的功能貨幣，而未結算的
   the functional currency of the Group, initially using the spot rate    交易則會以收市匯率於結算日重新換算。現貨匯率
   at the date of transaction and the unsettled transactions are          與收市匯率的換算差異於損益賬中確認，而人民幣
   retranslated at closing exchange rate at the balance sheet date.       貶值會對我們的年內溢利構成負面影響。
   Such translation differences between the spot rate and closing
   exchange rate are recognised in profit or loss, negatively
   affecting our profit for the year when RMB depreciated.


• Exchange difference also arises when i) incomes and expenses           • 此外，匯兌差異源於 i）中國內地分部的收支按平均
   of the Mainland China segment are translated into HKD, the             匯率換算為港元，即本集團呈列貨幣，而相應的資
   presentation currency of the Group, at the average exchange            產及負債按收市匯率換算；及 ii）中國內地分部的資
   rate, while the corresponding assets and liabilities are translated    產淨值於本財政年度的收市匯率較上個財政年度的
   at closing exchange rate and ii) the change in closing exchange        收市匯率有所變動。有關差異於權益中的換算儲備
   rates at the current financial year of the net assets of the           內確認入賬。
   Mainland China segment from the closing rates at the previous
   financial year. Such differences are recognised in the translation
   reserve in equity.

   impact on our financial performance:                                   的影響：

OUR “4T” FOR CORPORATE GOVERNANCE                                       我們的企業管治「4T」原則
Corporate governance provides a framework within which the Board        企業管治是董事會制定決策和開展本集團業務的框架。
forms their decisions and builds the Group’s businesses. Our “4T”       我們的企業管治「4T」原則指導企業管治常規的發展，
principles for corporate governance guide the development of our        支持本集團更妥善達成策略性目標，成就可持續增長
corporate governance practices, supporting the Group in better          和發展。
achieving our strategic objectives towards sustainable growth and
development.


                                     Implement transparent disclosures and constructive dialogues to foster genuine
     Transparent                     mutual understanding with stakeholders
     資訊透明 真確可知                       透過透明公開的披露和建設性對話，徹底促進與持份者的相互了解

      Our Board diversity policy                                             董事會多元化政策
      • Appropriate combination of competency and diversity of               • 以合適的能力組合和多元視野，以達致本公司的長
         perspectives in order to achieve the Company’s long-term goal         期目標和策略。
         and strategy.
      • Thorough considerations in board decision-making leverage on         • 董事會獲得更廣博的智慧和風險觸覺在決策時作出
         broader insights and risk intelligence, as well as better             透徹考慮，以及更佳地理解顧客及持份者。
         understanding on customers and stakeholders.
      • A broad concept of diversity attributable to various attributes:     • 視多元化為一個宏觀概念包括各類因素：
         – Personal skills and professional knowledge                          – 個人技能和專業知識
         – Regional and industry experience, reach to stakeholders             – 地區和行業經驗、與持份者的連繫
         – Gender, age, length of service and other qualities                  – 性別、年齡、服務年期和其他質素


      Our current board mix of knowledge and experience                      現屆董事會的知識和經驗組合
      Broad business exposures                                               廣泛的商業背景
      • Typical industries: retailing, manufacturing, property development   • 典型行業：零售、製造、物業發展
      • Emerging sectors serving for customers’ lifestyle and enjoyments     • 與消費者生活享受有關的新興行業
      • Worldwide market: China, Europe and the United States                • 環球市場：中國、歐洲和美國
      • Connections with public bodies and community groups                  • 與公共組織和社區團體的連繫


      Diverse professional knowledge                                         多元的專業知識
      • Retail, jewellery and brand development                              • 零售、珠寶和品牌發展
      • Technology and data analytics                                        • 科技和數據分析
      • Corporate strategies and listed company governance                   • 企業策略和上市公司管治
      • Capital market, finance and risk management                          • 資本市場、財務和風險管理


      Our diversity objectives for the future Board                          未來董事會的多元化目標
      • A broad spectrum of connections and intelligence across              • 跨越不同商業範疇擁有廣泛聯繫和商業智慧。
         multiple commercial fields.
      • Together contribute to high standards of corporate governance        • 共同為提高企業管治水平和持份者權益作出貢獻。
         and stakeholders’ interests.
      • A balanced mix of age group and board tenure.                        • 年齡組別和董事會任期組合均衡。
      • Gender balance with at least 3 female directors as an immediate      • 性別平衡：目前維持最少 3 名女性董事，到 2025 年
         target and minimum 20% representation by 2025. This target            或之前使女性比例達到 20% 或以上。董事會和提名
         will be reviewed on an annual basis by the Board and the              委員會將會每年檢討上述目標。
         Nomination Committee.

      management was 42%:58% while in the overall workforce was              為 42%、 男 性 為 58%， 而 整 體 員 工 中 女 性 佔 79%、

      the right position, in order to achieve employee diversity. The        目前的員工性別比例切合其營運狀況。
      Board considers that the current gender ratio of the workforce of

Based on the Nomination Committee’s review of a number of factors:     根據提名委員會已審查的多項因素：
• Business relationship and transactions with the Group                • 與本集團的業務關係及交易

   significant commitments
• Cross-directorships or significant links with other directors        • 通過參與其他公司或機構的事務而與本公司董事在
   through involvement in other companies or bodies                     其他董事會共事或有重要聯繫
• Each INED’s annual confirmation of independence received by          • 本公司接獲各獨立非執行董事作出的獨立性年度確認
   the Company
• Years of service as INED                                             • 作為獨立非執行董事的服務年期


The Board is of the view that all INEDs are independent, free from     董事會認為，所有獨立非執行董事均具獨立性，並無
any business or other relationship which could materially interfere    任何可能對他們行使判斷而構成重大干擾的任何業務
with the exercise of their judgement. Detailed elaboration on the      或其他關係。對於將在應屆股東週年大會重選的獨立
Board’s assessment are made in the circular to shareholders in         非執行董事，致股東的通函中將就董事會的評估作詳
respect of the INEDs to be re-elected in the forthcoming annual        細闡述。
general meeting.

Continuing professional development                                         持續專業發展
• Align knowledge and experience acquisition with a view to                 • 獲取所需知識和經驗以提升表現，從而達成我們的
   driving performance towards our strategic goals and exercising             策略目標，以及嚴謹監察其風險和成效。
   critical oversight on risk and performance.

   era of innovation and disruption.
• Foster a Board culture of ongoing learning and knowledge sharing.         • 推動董事會持續學習和分享知識的文化。


Our approach to ongoing learning                                            我們的持續學習方式
• Organise Board seminars, management forums and workshops                  • 就推動業務關鍵工作相關的主題組織董事會講座、
   on themes relevant for propelling the business priorities, where           管理層論壇和工作坊，邀請演講嘉賓與我們的領導
   our leaders can interact with inspirational guest speakers.                人員互動並啟發思維。
• Arrange on-site visits to explore on the competitive edges of             • 安排實地考察調研，以探索其他先進企業的競爭優勢。
   other advanced organisations.
• Custom-made newsletters sharing articles and videos related to            • 制作度身選材的通訊，與董事會分享熱門話題相關
   the Board’s hot topics.                                                    的文章和視頻。
• Conduct surveys for the Nomination Committee to understand                • 為提名委員會進行問卷調查，以了解各董事的學習
   learning needs of each director and analyse the directors’                 需要，並透過分析其培訓記錄，安排董事會學習活
   training records to prioritise the Board education activities.             動的優先次序。


Onboarding induction                                                        入職啟導

   environment of the Group, and directors’ duties.

   culture and corporate culture.
• Efficient and tailor-made on needs, depending on their Board              • 視乎董事的角色、專長和經驗而作有效且定制最合
   roles, their expertise and experience, enabling them to make               適的安排，使他們能夠盡快為董事會作出貢獻，尤
   contributions as early as possible to the Board, particularly on           其是在策略方面提供意見。
   providing advice on the strategies.

   expected from the new director.

   understand the Group’s existing plans and needs.                           團的現有計劃和需要。

   – Business model and strategies                                            – 業務模式和策略

1. BUSINESS OBJECTIVE AND STRATEGY                                        1. 業務目標和策略制定

Risks are inherent in our business activities and can relate to           我們的業務活動存在固有風險，其可能與策略性目標
strategic goals and business performance. We aim at integrating           和業績有關。我們旨在將風險管理融入策略規劃和監
risk management into the strategic planning and monitoring                察流程，從而形成務實和持續的流程。
process, resulting in a practical and continuous process.

                            events affecting our ability to achieve established objectives and strategies
    Risk and

Diversified risk          • To ensure the completeness of our risk inventory, we have established diversified risk identification
identification channels      channels and with ongoing optimisation in our top-down and bottom-up risk management approach
多樣化的風險識別渠道                   to identify internal, emerging, and changing risks that might affect the achievement of our business

                             為確保風險清單的完整性，我們建立多樣化的風險識別渠道，並持續優化我們自上而下及自下而上的風
                             險管理方案，以識別可能影響達致業務目標和策略的內部、新興和不斷變化的風險

風險組合觀                        overall risk appetite, our risk inventory is categorised to facilitate the formation of a portfolio view
                             of risk, allowing us to consider the type, severity, and interdependencies of common
                             risks collectively
                             為確保我們更有效評估剩餘風險狀況是否符合整體的風險承受度，我們將風險清單分類，形成風險組合
                             觀，使我們一併考慮共同的風險類型、嚴重程度和相互關係


                          • During FY2023, we took into account the latest situation of the Group and classified the risks faced
                             by the Group into five major categories, namely strategic, product and service, operational, financial
                             and governance, compliance and sustainability risks, and subdivided them into different risk items
                             with enhanced risk descriptions to help define the risk events
                             2023 財政年度內，我們結合集團的最新實際情況，把集團面對風險梳理後主要分為策略、產品與
                             服務、營運、財務和管治、合規及可持續發展五大類風險，並細分至不同風險項目及優化相關描
                             述，以幫助定義風險事件

Risk inventory            • We will perform a periodic review on the risk inventory in centralised approach to ensure the

Main features of the risk evaluation framework                             風險評估框架的主要特點


Holistic risk assessment   • The severity of risks is assessed at multiple levels by risk owners, Corporate Governance
全面的風險評估                       Department, and GRMC to ensure comprehensive risk assessment
                              風險承擔者、企業管治部和集團風險管理委員會從多個層面評估風險的嚴重性，以確保全面的風險
                              評估


                           • Risk owners in operational units are responsible to assess the risks individually at least once a year
                              and the operational assessment result will be escalated to the Corporate Governance Department
                              for entity level assessment
                              營運單位的風險承擔負責人負責至少每年個別評估風險一次，並將營運評估結果上報企業管治部進行
                              企業層面評估


                           • The focus of the entity level assessment is to assess the risk interaction, in which the Corporate
                              Governance Department will consider those severe risks identified at the operational level and
                              group common risks across operational units and assess the risk level collectively
                              企業層面評估的重點是評估風險的相互關係，其中企業管治部將考慮該等在營運層面識別的嚴重風險，
                              並將各營運單位的共同風險分組，一併評估共同風險的風險水平


                           • The final assessment result is depicted on the risk heat map, which will be reviewed by GRMC
                              最終評估結果將呈現於集團關鍵風險熱點圖，並由集團風險管理委員會審視

Relevant and appropriate • Evaluation criteria including the impact to business and likelihood of occurrence are used to
risk evaluation criteria   assess the severity of risks
相關和適當的風險評估標準                  利用評估準則（包括對業務的影響和發生的可能性）評估風險的嚴重性


                           • During the period, we continue to refine our risk assessment tools to establish multi-
                              dimensional risk consequence rating profiles against the Group’s risk appetite focus to help
                              facilitate comprehensive risk assessment
                              期內，我們持續優化風險評估工具，對照集團風險偏好關注方向，建立多維度的風險後果描述，協助促
                              進全面的風險評估


                           • In addition to the evaluation criteria that we would use for evaluating operational risks, we also
                              use“importance to stakeholders”as one of the criteria to prioritise the ESG-related risks. We
                              engage both internal and external stakeholders to identify and evaluate ESG-related risks
                              which may have significant impacts to our stakeholders
                              除一般用於評估經營風險的因素外，我們亦將「對持份者的重要性」作為評估可持續發展相關風險
                              優先次序的準則之一。邀請內部和外部持份者參與識別和評估可能對他們產生重大影響的可持續
                              發展相關風險

      the actual results. Management also needs to exercise                 應用本集團會計政策時亦需行使判斷力。

      Estimates are continually evaluated. They are based on                估算持續評估，並以過往經驗及其他因素（包括
      historical experience and other factors, including                    可對實體構成財務影響且在若干情況下相信屬合
      expectations of future events that may have a financial               理的未來事件之預期）作基礎。
      impact on the entity and that are believed to be reasonable
      under the circumstances.

      causing a material adjustment to the carrying amounts of              調 整 的 估 算 及 假 設，根 據 財 務 報 表 附 註 載 列 於

8.    INTEREST INCOME AND FINANCE                                        8.   利息收入及融資成本
      COSTS

        Accounting Policy                                                     會計政策
        Interest income                                                       利息收入
        Interest income from financial assets at FVPL is included in          來自按公允值計入損益的金融資產的利息收入
        the net fair value gains and losses on these assets.                  計入該等資產的公允值收益及虧損淨額中。


        Interest income on financial assets at amortised cost                 按攤銷成本計量的金融資產的利息收入使用實
        calculated using the effective interest method is recognised          際利率法計算，於損益確認為其他收入。
        in the profit or loss as part of other income.

        Interest income is presented as finance income where it is            持作現金管理用途的金融資產賺取利息收入
        earned from financial assets that are held for cash                   時，利息收入會呈列為融資收入。任何其他利
        management purposes. Any other interest income is                     息收入則計入其他收入。
        included in other income.

        Interest income is calculated by applying the effective               利息收入將實際利率應用至金融資產賬面總值
        interest rate to the gross carrying amount of a financial             計算得出，惟其後出現信貸虧損的金融資產除
        asset except for financial assets that subsequently become            外。就信貸減值金融資產，實際利率應用於金
        credit-impaired. For credit-impaired financial assets the             融資產淨賬面值（扣除虧損撥備後）。
        effective interest rate is applied to the net carrying amount
        of the financial assets (after deduction of the loss
        allowance).


        Borrowing costs                                                       借貸成本
        General and specific borrowing costs that are directly                直接源自收購、建築或生產合資格資產的一般
        attributable to the acquisition, construction or production of        及特定借貸成本於完成及籌備資產以作其擬定
        a qualifying asset are capitalised during the period of time          用途或銷售所需期間內資本化。合資格資產指
        that is required to complete and prepare the asset for its            需要大量時間籌備以作擬定用途或銷售的資產。
        intended use or sale. Qualifying assets are assets that
        necessarily take a substantial period of time to get ready for
        their intended use or sale.

        Investment income earned on the temporary investment of               在特定借款撥作合資格資產支出前之暫時投資
        specific borrowings pending their expenditure on qualifying           所賺取之投資收入，須從合資格資本化之借款
        assets is deducted from the borrowing costs eligible for              成本中扣除。
        capitalisation.

        Other borrowing costs are expensed in the period in which             其他借貸成本於其產生之期間內支銷。
        they are incurred.

          positions taken in tax returns with respect to situations in                              未能確定的稅收待遇。本集團根據最有可能出

12. EARNINGS PER SHARE                                                     12. 每股盈利

        Accounting Policy                                                    會計政策
        (a)   Basic earnings per share                                       (a)   每股基本盈利
              Basic earnings per share is calculated by dividing:                  每股基本盈利按：


              • profit attributable to shareholders of the Company,                • 本 公 司 股 東 應 佔 溢 利（不 包 括 支 付 普
                     excluding any costs of servicing equity other than               通股以外權益的任何成本）
                     ordinary shares


              • by the weighted average number of ordinary shares                  • 除以財政年度內已發行普通股加權平
                     outstanding during the financial year, adjusted for              均數計算，並就年內已發行普通股（不
                     bonus elements in ordinary shares issued during                  包括庫存股）的花紅調整。
                     the year and excluding treasury shares.


        (b) Diluted earnings per share                                       (b) 每股攤薄盈利
              Diluted earnings per share adjusts the figures used in               每股攤薄盈利按釐定每股基本盈利所用
              the determination of basic earnings per share to take                數據並計及以下項目後調整：
              into account:


              • the after-income tax effect of interest and other                  • 與潛在攤薄普通股相關的利息及其他
                     financing costs associated with dilutive potential               融資成本的除所得稅後影響；及
                     ordinary shares; and


              • the weighted average number of additional                          • 已 發 行 額 外 普 通 股 加 權 平 均 數（假 定
                     ordinary shares that would have been outstanding                 潛在攤薄普通股全部轉換）。
                     assuming the conversion of all dilutive potential
                     ordinary shares.


      The calculation of the basic earnings per share for the year is        年度每股基本盈利是基於本公司股東應佔年內綜
      based on the consolidated profit attributable to shareholders          合 溢 利， 以 及 年 內 已 發 行 股 份 10,000,000,000
      of the Company for the year and on the number of                       股（2022 年：10,000,000,000 股）計算。
      10,000,000,000 (2022: 10,000,000,000) shares in issue
      during the year.


      Diluted earnings per share is the same as basic earnings per           由於兩個年度並無潛在普通股攤薄效應，故每股
      share as there was no potential ordinary shares dilution               攤薄盈利與每股基本盈利相同。
      during both years.

        Accounting Policy                                                  會計政策
        Leases are recognised as a right-of-use asset and a                租賃於租賃資產可供本集團使用當日會確認為
        corresponding liability at the date at which the leased asset      使用權資產及相關負債。
        is available for use by the Group.


        Contracts may contain both lease and non-lease                     合約可能包含租賃及非租賃成份。本集團按照
        components. The Group allocates the consideration in the           租賃及非租賃成份相應的獨立價格，將合約代
        contract to the lease and non-lease components based on            價分配至租賃及非租賃成份。然而，對本集團
        their relative stand-alone prices. However, for leases of real     為承租人的房地產租賃而言，其選擇將租賃及
        estate for which the Group is a lessee, it has elected not to      非 租 賃 成 份 視 為 單 一 租 賃 成 份， 並 無 將 兩 者
        separate lease and non-lease components and instead                區分。
        accounts for these as a single lease component.


        Assets and liabilities arising from a lease are initially          租賃產生的資產及負債初始按現值計量。租賃
        measured on a present value basis. Lease liabilities include       負債包括下列租賃付款的淨現值：
        the net present value of the following lease payments:


        • fixed payments (including in-substance fixed payments),          • 固 定 付 款（包 括 實 質 固 定 付 款）扣 減 任 何 應
           less any lease incentives receivable;                             收租賃優惠；


        • variable lease payment that are based on an index or a           • 取決於指數或比率的浮動租賃付款（初始於
           rate, initially measured using the index or rate as at the        開始日期利用指數或比率計量）；
           commencement date;


        • amounts expected to be payable by the Group under                • 本集團根據餘值擔保預期應付的金額；
           residual value guarantees;


        • the exercise price of a purchase option if the Group is          • 在本集團合理確定行使採購選擇權的情況下
           reasonably certain to exercise that option; and                   採購選擇權的行使價；及


        • payments of penalties for terminating the lease, if the          • 在租期反映本集團行使該選擇權的情況下，
           lease term reflects the Group exercising that option.             終止租賃的罰款。


        Lease payments to be made under reasonably certain                 根據合理確定延續選擇權支付的租賃付款亦計
        extension options are also included in the measurement of          入負債計量之內。
        the liability.


        The lease payments are discounted using the interest rate          租賃付款採用租賃所隱含的利率予以貼現。倘
        implicit in the lease. If that rate cannot be readily              無法釐定該利率（本集團的租賃一般屬此類情
        determined, which is generally the case for leases in the          況），則使用承租人遞增借貸利率，即個別承租
        Group, the lessee’s incremental borrowing rate is used,            人在類似經濟環境中按類似條款、抵押及條件
        being the rate that the individual lessee would have to pay        借入獲得與使用權資產價值類似的資產所需資
        to borrow the funds necessary to obtain an asset of similar        金必須支付的利率。
        value to the right-of-use asset in a similar economic
        environment with similar terms, security and conditions.

16. INVESTMENT PROPERTIES                                                 16. 投資物業

        Accounting Policy                                                   會計政策
        Investment properties are properties held for long-term             投資物業指為長線租金回報持有且不由本集團
        rental yields and are not occupied by the Group.                    佔用的物業。


        Investment properties are initially measured at cost, including     投資物業初步按成本（包括相關交易成本及借
        related transaction costs and where applicable borrowing            貸 成 本（如 適用））計 量。初 始 確認 後，投 資物
        costs. Subsequent to initial recognition, investment                業按成本減其後累計折舊及任何累計減值虧損
        properties are stated at cost less subsequent accumulated           列賬。
        depreciation and any accumulated impairment losses.


        If there is a transfer from investment property to owner-           倘將投資物業轉撥至自用物業，以擁有人開始
        occupied property evidenced by the commencement of                  佔用為證，則該物業於其後入賬時按變更用途
        owner’s occupation, the property shall be measured at its           日期之賬面值計量。
        carrying amount at the date of change in use for
        subsequent accounting.


        Depreciation is recognised so as to write off the cost of           投資物業按估計可使用年期，經考慮其估計剩
        investment properties over their estimated useful lives and         餘價值後，樓宇及土地部分按直線基準分別於
        after taking into account their estimated residual value,           20 年 或 租 約 年 期 確 認 折 舊， 以 撇 銷 投 資 物 業
        using the straight-line basis over 20 years for building            成本。
        element or lease term for land element.


        An investment property is derecognised upon disposal or             投資物業於出售後或投資物業永久不再使用且
        when the investment property is permanently withdrawn               預期出售不會產生未來經濟利益時終止確認。
        from use and no future economic benefits are expected               終止確認物業產生的任何收益或虧損（按該資
        from the disposal. Any gain or loss arising on derecognition        產之出售所得款項淨額與賬面值之差額計算）
        of the property (calculated as the difference between the           於該物業終止確認期間計入損益。
        net disposal proceeds and the carrying amount of the asset)
        is included in profit or loss in the period in which the
        property is derecognised.

22. DEFERRED TAXATION                                                       22. 遞延稅項

        Accounting Policy                                                     會計政策
        Deferred income tax is provided in full, using the liability          遞延所得稅採用負債法就資產負債之稅基與它
        method, on temporary differences arising between the tax              們在綜合財務報表之賬面值兩者之短暫時差作
        bases of assets and liabilities and their carrying amounts in         全數撥備。然而如遞延稅項負債因初始確認為
        the consolidated financial statements. However, deferred              商譽而產生，則不予以確認。若遞延稅項來自
        tax liabilities are not recognised if they arise from the initial     交易（不包括業務合併）中對資產或負債的初步
        recognition of goodwill. Deferred income tax is also not              確認，而在交易時不影響會計損益或應課稅盈
        accounted for if it arises from initial recognition of an asset       虧，亦不作記賬。遞延稅項採用在報告期末前
        or liability in a transaction other than a business combination       已頒佈或實際頒佈之稅率（或法例）釐定，並預
        that at the time of the transaction affects neither accounting        期在有關之遞延稅項資產實現或遞延稅項負債
        nor taxable profit or loss. Deferred income tax is                    結算時應用。
        determined using tax rates (and laws) that have been
        enacted or substantively enacted by the end of the
        reporting period and are expected to apply when the related
        deferred income tax asset is realised or the deferred
        income tax liability is settled.


        Deferred tax assets are recognised only if it is probable that        遞延稅項資產僅在未來應課稅金額將可用於動
        future taxable amounts will be available to utilise those             用該等暫時差額及虧損時予以確認。
        temporary differences and losses.


        Deferred tax liabilities and assets are not recognised for            倘本公司能控制撥回暫時差額的時間及該等差
        temporary differences between the carrying amount and                 異很可能不會於可見將來撥回，則不會就境外
        tax bases of investments in foreign operations where the              業務投資賬面值與稅基之間的暫時差額確認遞
        company is able to control the timing of the reversal of the          延稅項負債及資產。
        temporary differences and it is probable that the differences
        will not reverse in the foreseeable future.


        Deferred tax assets and liabilities are offset where there is         當有可依法強制執行的權利將即期稅項資產與
        a legally enforceable right to offset current tax assets and          負債抵銷，而遞延稅項結餘與同一稅務機構相
        liabilities and where the deferred tax balances relate to the         關時，則可將遞延稅項資產與負債抵銷。當實
        same taxation authority. Current tax assets and tax liabilities       體有可依法強制執行抵銷權利且有意按淨額基
        are offset where the entity has a legally enforceable right to        準結算或同時變現資產及清償負債時，則即期
        offset and intends either to settle on a net basis, or to             稅項資產與稅項負債抵銷。
        realise the asset and settle the liability simultaneously.


        Current and deferred tax is recognised in profit or loss,             即期及遞延稅項將於損益中確認，惟與該稅項
        except to the extent that it relates to items recognised in           有關之項目於其他全面收益或直接於權益中確
        other comprehensive income or directly in equity. In this             認除外。就此而言，稅項亦分別於其他全面收
        case, the tax is also recognised in other comprehensive               益或直接在權益中確認。
        income or directly in equity, respectively.

27. BANK BORROWINGS                                                                                 27. 銀行貸款

        Accounting Policy                                                                             會計政策
        Borrowings are initially recognised at fair value, net of                                     借款最初乃按公允值（扣除已產生的交易成本）
        transaction costs incurred. Borrowings are subsequently                                       確認。借款其後按攤銷成本計量，如扣除交易
        measured at amortised cost. Any difference between the                                        成本之後的所得款項及贖回金額出現差額，則
        proceeds (net of transaction costs) and the redemption                                        於借款期內以實際利率法於損益內確認。在貸
        amount is recognised in profit or loss over the period of the                                 款很有可能部分或全部提取的情況下，就設立
        borrowings using the effective interest method. Fees paid                                     貸款融資支付的費用乃確認為貸款交易成本。
        on the establishment of loan facilities are recognised as                                     在 此 情 況 下， 該 費 用 將 遞 延 至 提 取 貸 款 發 生
        transaction costs of the loan to the extent that it is probable                               時。在並無跡象顯示該貸款很有可能部分或全
        that some or all of the facility will be drawn down. In this                                  部提取的情況下，該費用撥充資本作為流動資
        case, the fee is deferred until the draw down occurs. To                                      金服務的預付款項，並於其相關融資期間內予
        the extent there is no evidence that it is probable that some                                 以攤銷。
        or all of the facility will be drawn down, the fee is
        capitalised as a prepayment for liquidity services and
        amortised over the period of the facility to which it relates.


        Borrowings are removed from the consolidated statement                                        當合約中規定的責任解除、取消或屆滿時，借
        of financial position when the obligation specified in the                                    貸從綜合財務狀況表中剔除。已消除或轉讓給
        contract is discharged, cancelled or expired. The difference                                  另一方的金融負債的賬面值與已支付代價（包
        between the carrying amount of a financial liability that has                                 括已轉讓的任何非現金資產或所承擔的負債）
        been extinguished or transferred to another party and the                                     之間的差額，在損益中確認為融資成本。
        consideration paid, including any non-cash assets
        transferred or liabilities assumed, is recognised in profit or
        loss as finance costs.


        Borrowings are classified as current liabilities unless the                                   借款分類為流動負債，惟本集團擁有無條件權
        Group has an unconditional right to defer settlement of the                                   利可將負債之清償延遲至報告期後最少十二個
        liability for at least 12 months after the reporting period.                                  月則除外。

      28. GOLD LOANS                                                                 28. 黃金借貸

               Accounting Policy                                                       會計政策
               Gold loans to be repaid by cash are designated as financial             將以現金償還的黃金借貸屬於按公允值計入損
               liabilities at fair value through profit or loss as the gold loans      益的金融負債，因為黃金借貸組成包含一個或
               form part of a contract containing one or more embedded                 多個嵌入式衍生工具之合約部分。將以實體黃
               derivatives. Gold loans to be repaid by physical gold are               金償還的黃金借貸分類為按公允值計入損益的
               classified as liabilities at fair value through profit or loss.         負債。


               Gain or losses on gold loans are recognised in the                      黃金借貸的收益或虧損於綜合損益表內確認，
               consolidated statement of profit or loss, except for the                惟該等按公允值計入損益的金融負債因本集團
               gains or losses arising from the Group’s own credit risk                自身信貸風險產生的收益或虧損則計入其他全
               relating financial liabilities at fair value through profit or loss     面收益呈列，且不會重新分類至綜合損益表。
               which are presented in other comprehensive income with                  於綜合損益表確認的公允值收益或虧損淨額並
               no subsequent reclassification to the consolidated                      不包括任何扣除此等負債的利息。
               statement of profit or loss. The net fair value gain or loss
               recognised in the consolidated statement of profit or loss
               does not include any interest charged on these liabilities.


             Gold loans are borrowed to reduce the impact of fluctuations              借取黃金借貸目的在於減低黃金存貨受黃金價格

             borrowing from banks and the amounts payable are pegged                   與黃金價格掛鈎。
             to gold prices.

32. CAPITAL RISK MANAGEMENT                                             32. 資本風險管理
      The Group manages its capital to ensure that the group              本集團管理資本旨在確保集團實體可持續經營，
      entities will be able to continue as a going concern while          並透過維持債務與權益的最佳平衡而為股東提供
      maximising the return to shareholders through the                   最大回報。
      optimisation of the debt and equity balance.


      The capital structure of the Group consists of bank                 本集團的資本架構包括銀行貸款、黃金借貸和本
      borrowings, gold loans and equity attributable to                   公司股東應佔股權（包括綜合財務報表所披露之
      shareholders of the Company, comprising share capital,              股本、儲備及保留溢利）。
      reserves and retained profits as disclosed in the consolidated
      financial statements.


      The management of the Group reviews the capital structure           本集團管理層定期檢討資本架構。本集團會考慮
      regularly. The Group considers the cost of capital and the          資本成本及各類資本相關的風險，亦透過派付股
      risks associated with each class of capital, and will balance       息、發行新股、籌集銀行貸款及黃金借貸平衡本
      its overall capital structure through the payment of dividends,     集團整體資本架構。
      new share issues as well as the raising of bank borrowings
      and gold loans.

               bonds that are denominated in the currency in which the              定。就債券並無深入市場的國家而言，則利用

               the terms of the related obligation. In countries where there

               in the current period. The net interest cost is calculated by        允值計算。
               applying the discount rate to the net balance of the defined
